title.zh: Crypto wallet creators now have just 24 hours to alert regulators when flaws are exploited
title.en: Crypto wallet creators now have just 24 hours to alert regulators when flaws are exploited

current_state.zh: Under the EU's Cyber Resilience Act, manufacturers of connected hardware and software crypto wallets must now report actively exploited vulnerabilities or severe security incidents to cyber authorities within 24 hours, with full notifications due within 72 hours.
current_state.en: Under the EU's Cyber Resilience Act, manufacturers of connected hardware and software crypto wallets must now report actively exploited vulnerabilities or severe security incidents to cyber authorities within 24 hours, with full notifications due within 72 hours.
